newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's LUKoil, ARCO sign deal.
newsitem.headline: Russia's LUKoil, ARCO sign deal.

text.p: Russia's largest oil producer OAO NK LUKoil 0#LKOH.RUO and the Atlantic Richfield Co signed a joint venture agreement in Washington on Friday evening worth $5 billion LUKoil said.
A LUKoil statement said the companies had founded a joint venture, SP LUKARKO, to prospect for and develop oil in the former Soviet Union.
It said ARCO would extend a $4.5 billion credit line to LUKARKO, total investment would be about $5 billion and 1997 investment would be about $400 million.
ARCO owns 7.99 percent of LUKoil. LUKoil will have a 54 percent stake in the new joint venture and ARCO will have a 46 percent stake.
